"Who's the cat that won't cop out when there's danger all about?"

"Mace!"

"Right on."

Mace makes his first appearance in this game along with his other Jedi pals in this set. Sporting impressive numbers like some of the other strong Jedi Masters, he also has good game text when it comes to Amidala. Like other Episode I Jedi, he's lived the good life in the Council Chamber so he will feel more comfortable there and gain all his useful game text.

One great use for Mace is taking on the Agents Of The Black Sun objective. They will not be able to deploy [[Maul]] so they will automatically lose 2 Force when you have Mace at the Chamber and Amidala wandering at a battleground site. Can you dig that? Just watch out for Xizor and the Emperor who happen to live on [[Coruscant (location) (2){{!}}Coruscant]] too.

Combo:

Mace stays, others go away. He'll serve Dark Side guys a Royale with Cheese along with a knuckle sandwich.
